answer: Account the cost of replication before granting weight. Each identity stakes and must renew with fresh work every epoch or the stake expires. Compute the delta between what a clone earns and what it costs to keep alive, then publish that number. A farm in the harbor must fund N stakes plus N work renewals to hold N seats, and any replayed submission drains a vault it cannot refill. The economy pays only the margin between honest work and the cheapest viable copy.
